name: Iceland
hook: Waterfalls, ice caves, and the aurora
description: The Ring Road at a pace that leaves room for the weather to change your plans — glacier lagoons, black-sand coastlines, and nights left open for the lights.
bestTime: June–August for the Ring Road, September–March for the aurora

quickFacts.flightNote: ~5–6hr direct from the US East Coast
quickFacts.climate: Subarctic — mild summers, cold, dark winters

topExperiences: A self-driven stretch of the Ring Road
The Jökulsárlón glacier lagoon by boat
A night chasing the aurora, away from town light
